caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular container with rounded corners, viewed at an angle that shows both the front and a portion of the interior. The container is primarily painted a light blue color and features decorative patterns. Along the bottom edge, there is a border composed of alternating yellow and white flowers with green leaves, interspersed with black details. Above this border, there is a narrower white horizontal design with stylized leaf-like shapes repeated in a band. The upper section of the container displays part of a painted scene: a white or light-colored dog or animal stands on green grass, holding a long stick or object, against a background that includes foliage. The top edge of the container reveals a beige or light tan interior. The background of the drawing is plain, off-white or cream, with no additional objects or scenery.
title: Bandbox
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
